## Problem and change

Describe the problem, the change, and any data-retention tradeoff.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] Relevant browser tests pass, or the untested scope is explained.
- [ ] A regression test covers the behavior.
- [ ] All added fixtures are synthetic. No production HARs or credentials.
- [ ] Documentation describes any change to retained fields or limits.

## Screenshots (UI changes only)

Use the built-in synthetic demo.
